title: Cofree presheaf Cech complex is exact in positive degrees
statement: For C : Type u, Category.{v} C, T : Type (max u v), a chosen SiteCechComplex and P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}, the positive-degree Cech complex of the cofree presheaf Presheaf.cofree P is exact.

proof.text: Evaluate at each object Z and map to a chosen fibre product. For each fixed composite v : Z → U admitting a lift to the family, choose one lift once, independently of the tuple. Every tuple supplies existence by its zeroth projection. Prepend that fixed lift to each tuple over v; the universal property uniquely determines the inserted tuple map. Faces preserve v, so the same chosen lift is used for all faces. Evaluating the cocycle equation on the prepended tuple identifies the original cochain with the differential of the inserted cochain (the nonzero faces contribute its negative in the cocycle equation).
